comment:
My dad loved the first one. As the years went on, we both eagerly awaited the second movie. When it was eventually playing in cinemas, he was admitted into hospital after a routine checkup when the doctors discovered he had a blood clot. During one of my visits to him at the hospital, we were talking about the second movie as I had just seen it. I said to him "I can't wait for you to see it when it starts streaming". He replied humorously "Yeah, I just hope I live that long!". But, tragically, he didn't. He passed away in hospital a week later on Christmas Day 2022. He had been waiting years to see it only to pass away during its release. 

Now, every time I watch these films, I think of him. Both he and I loved nature, and throughout my life up until the time he passed we very often talked for hours about the interconnectedness of flora and fauna; how we are all made of the same thing, and the destruction mankind brings upon it all.  Avatar was very special to him
